description: This source file defines a JavaScript class 'Time' for handling time input fields with HTML rendering and updating logic, mainly used in a web-based CRM interface for time selection.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A JavaScript class for managing time input fields, including rendering HTML select elements for hours, minutes, and optional meridiem ('am'/'pm'), and updating internal value based on user input.

methods.name: html(callback)
methods.description: Generates HTML code for the time input fields, including select dropdowns for hours, minutes, and meridiem if applicable, with event handlers for update callbacks.

methods.name: update()
methods.description: Updates the internal time value based on the selected hours, minutes, and meridiem from the dropdowns.
